plan.archetype: Frontloaded damage into poison scaling and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Bring burst damage for the 160-HP stun threshold, sustained poison, upgraded Weak, scaling block, and a defensive potion. Enter healthy.
plan.summary: Take efficient damage first, then establish poison and stronger defense. Remove basics after replacing their roles. Fight elites with adequate HP and potions; upgrade core cards when safe.

plan.archetype: Efficient attacks transitioning into sustained poison and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Enter healthy; upgrade Predator or Haze, acquire sustained poison and scaling defense, and save useful potions. Burst through the 160-HP stun threshold.
